spans.s: गो॑—तम (गो॑-), m. (superl.) N. of a Ṛṣi belonging to the family of Aṅgiras with the patr. Rāhū-gaṇa (author of RV. i, 74-93), RV.; AV.; ŚBr. i, xi, xiv; ṢaḍvBr. &c.
(for गौत्˚) N. of the chief disciple of Mahā-vīra
of a lawyer (cf. गौतम॑)
of the founder of the Nyāya phil.
‘the largest ox’ and ‘N. of the founder of Nyāya phil.’, Naiṣ. xvii, 75
N. of a son of Karṇika, Buddh.
? MBh. xiii, 4490 (cf. -दम)
pl. (Pāṇ. ii, 4, 65) the descendants of the Ṛṣi Gotama, RV.; ĀśvŚr. xii, 10; Lāṭy.
गो॑—तम n. a kind of poison, Gal.
&c. See गो॑, p. 364, col. 2.
गो॑—तमी f. v.l. for गौत्˚ in g. गौरादि
गो—तम—गौर m. = गौर-गोतम, the white Gotama,
Gaṇar. 89
, Sch.
गो—तम—पृच्छा f. ‘questions of (Mahā-vīra's pupil) Gotama (put forth in a discussion with Pārśva's pupil Keśin)’, N. of a Jain work
गो—तम—स्तोम m. N. of an Ekāha sacrifice, ĀśvŚr.; ŚāṅkhŚr. (cf. ŚBr. xiii, 5, 1, 1)
गो—तम—स्वामिन् m. Mahā-vīra's pupil Gotama
गो—त˚मान्वय m. N. of Śākya-muni, L.
गो—त˚मी-पुत्र m. ‘son of Gotamī’, N. of a king (50 B.C. or A.D.), Inscr.; VāyuP.; MatsyaP.
गो—त˚मेश्वर-तीर्थ n. N. of a Tīrtha, ŚivaP.
गो—तर m. (compar.) a better ox, Pāṇ. v, 3, 55; Pat.
गो—तरा f. a better cow, ib.
गो—तरणि a kind of flower, Buddh.; L.
गो—तर्पण n. anything arranged for the pleasure of cows, AV.Pariś. lxix, 7.
गो—तल्लज m. an excellent cow, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 66, Sch.
गो—ता f. ‘cowship’, (in dialect) a cow, Pat.
Introd. 35
; 97, and on
Vārtt. 6
गो—तीर्थ n. N. of a Tīrtha, Suśr. vi, 31, 6
गो—तीर्थक m. with च्छेद, an oblique cut applied to fistula of the rectum, Suśr. iv, 8, 11.
गो—तुल्य m. ‘resembling an ox’, the Gayal, Gal.
गो—त्र॑ n. (√ त्रै) protection or shelter for cows, cow-pen, cow-shed, stable for cattle, stable (in general), hurdle, enclosure, RV. (once m., viii, 50, 10)

‘family enclosed by the hurdle’, family, race, lineage, kin, ChUp.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; Kauś. &c. (a polysyllabic fem. in ई shortens this vowel before गोत्र in comp. [e.g. ब्राह्मणिगोत्रा, ‘a Brāhman woman only by descent or name’, Kāś.] Pāṇ. vi, 3, 43 ff.)
the family name, ĀśvGṛ.; MBh. xiii, 548; VarBṛS.
name (in general), Śak. vi, 5; Ragh. &c.

(in Gr.) the grandson and his descendants if no older offspring of the same ancestor than this grandson lives (if the son lives the grandson is called युवन्), Pāṇ. ii, 4, 63; iv, 1, 89 ff. and 162 ff.; 2, 111 and 3, 80 and 126
an affix used for forming a patr. L.
a tribe, subdivision (in the Brāhman caste 49 Gotras are reckoned and supposed to be sprung from and named after celebrated teachers, as Śāṇḍilya, Kaśyapa, Gautama, Bharad-vāja, &c.), W.
a genus, class, species, W.
a multitude, L.
increase, L.
possession, L.
a forest, L.
a field, L.
an umbrella or parasol, L.
knowledge of probabilities, L.
गो—त्र॑ (अस्), m. a mountain (a meaning probably derived fr. -भि॑द्), BhP. ii, iii, vi
a cloud (cf. -भि॑द्), Naigh. i, 10
a road, L.
&c. See ib., col. 3.
गो॑—त्रा (आ), f. a herd of kine, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 51
the earth, L. (cf. गोत्रेश)
गो॑—त्रम् (अम्), ind. after a verb denoting repetition and implying a blame, Pāṇ. viii, 1, 27 and 57
गो॑—त्रेण (एण), ind. instr. with regard to one's family name g. प्रकृत्य्-आदि
गो॑—त्र॑—कर्तृ m. the founder of a family, MBh. xiii, 248
गो—त्र—कारिन् mfn. founding a family, Pravar.
गो—त्र—कीला f. (= अचल-क्˚) the earth, L.
गो—त्र—क्षान्ति f. N. of a Kiṃnara virgin, Kāraṇḍ. i

गो—त्र—ज mfn. born in the same family, relation (in law, nearly = ‘Gentile’ of Roman law, and applied to kindred of the same general family, who are connected by offerings of food and water; hence opposed to बन्धु or cognate kindred not partaking in the offerings to common ancestors), Yājñ. ii, 135; BhP. iii, 7, 24; Kathās. vi, xxii, iic
गो—त्र—देवता f. family deity, Siṃhās. iv
गो—त्र—नामन् n. the family name, ŚāṅkhGṛ. i, 6, 4
गो—त्र—पट m. a genealogical table, pedigree, Lāṭy. i, 2, 24, Sch.
गो—त्र—प्रवर-दीप m. N. of wk.
गो॑-त्र-प्रव˚र—निर्णय m. N. of wk.
गो॑-त्र-प्रव˚र—मञ्जरी f. N. of wk.
गो—त्र—भाज् mfn. belonging to the family, Gaut. xxviii, 33
गो—त्र—भि॑द् mfn. opening the cow-pens of the sky (‘splitting the clouds or mountains’, Sāy.; said of Indra and Bṛhaspati's vehicle), RV. ii, 23, 3; vi, 17, 2 and x, 103, 6; VS. xx, 38
गो—त्र—भि॑द् m. ‘splitting the mountains (with his thunderbolt, cf. अद्रि-भि॑द्)’, Indra, Ragh.; Kum. ii, 52
‘Indra’ and ‘destroyer of families’, Rājat. i, 92
‘Indra’ and ‘destroyer of names’, Śiś. ix, 80
गो—त्र—भूमि f. ‘family-range’, one of the periods in a Śrāvaka's life, Buddh.; L.
गो—त्र—मय mfn. forming a family (with क्षात्र, ‘a Kṣatriya family’), Bālar. iii, 60
गो—त्र—रिक्थ n. du. the family name and the inheritance, Mn. ix, 142
गो—त्र—रिक्थांश m. in comp. the family name and part of the inheritance, 165
गो—त्र—वत् mfn. belonging to a noble family, R. ii, 98, 24
गो—त्र—वर्धन m. N. of a prince, Kathās. lxv
गो—त्र—वृक्ष m. N. of a tree, Bhpr.
गो—त्र—व्रत n. a family rule, Bhartṛ. (Mudr. ii, 18; Subh.)
गो—त्र—स्थिति f. ‘id.’ and ‘standing like a mountain’
गो—त्राख्या f. family name, patronymic, L.
गो—त्रादि m. a Gaṇa of Pāṇ. viii, 1, 27
गो—˚त्रान्त m. ‘destruction of families’ and ‘destruction of mountains’, Rājat. v, 377
(scil. शब्द) ‘ending with a Gotra affix’, a patronymic, L.
गो—˚त्राभिधायम् ind. so as to name one's name, Bhaṭṭ. iii, 50
गो—˚त्रेश m. ‘earth-lord’, a king
गो—˚त्रोच्चार m. ‘recitation of the family pedigree’, N. of a ceremony, RTL. p. 407.
गो—˚त्रक n. family, Yājñ. ii, 85.
गो—˚त्रिक mfn. relating to a family (with कर्मन्, ‘the consciousness of family descent’, one of the 4 pure Karmans), Jain.
&c. See ib., col. 3.
गो—˚त्रिन् mfn. belonging to the same family, relation, Vet. xv, 8/9
&c. See ib., col. 3.
गो—˚त्रि-त्व n. relationship.
गो—त्व॑ n. the being a cow, state of a cow, MaitrS.; TāṇḍyaBr. xvi; MārkP.; RāmatUp.; Sarvad.
the nature of an ox, Kāvyād. i, 6.
गो—त्वच् f. ‘an ox-hide or cow's hide’
गो—˚त्वग्-ज mfn. made of leather, VarYogay. vi, 18.
